result.title: LLMVC: Large Language Model-Guided Generative Video Compression
result.summary: Recent generative video methods achieve strong perceptual compression by encoding videos into compact latent representations and reconstructing them with powerful generative decoders. However, visual encoders must compress both high-level semantics and dense visual details into a unified latent space, which complicates entropy coding and decoding and may cause semantic drift under aggressive compression. In this work, we propose Large Language Model-Guided Video Compression (LLMVC), which leverages the summarization capability of frozen video large language models (Video-LLMs) to generate compact semantic tokens aligned with temporal latent slices for guiding video compression. Specifically, Hybrid Bidirectional Bimodal Attention (HBBA) enables bidirectional interactions between visual and semantic features during encoding and decoding. Semantic-Conditioned Cross-Attention (SCCA) incorporates semantic features into probability modeling during entropy coding. These semantic features provide high-level guidance throughout the pipeline, improving representation quality and encouraging semantic consistency through a transmitted text side channel. Experiments on UVG, MCL-JCV, and HEVC show that LLMVC consistently improves compression performance over traditional and recent neural video compression methods in terms of LPIPS and DISTS, while also achieving better fidelity than recent perceptual codecs.

AI.brief_summary: LLMVC 用冻结的 Video-LLM 为各时间 latent 片段生成紧凑语义 token 作为文本侧信道，并通过双向双模态注意力与语义条件交叉注意力引导熵编码与生成式解码，以缓解激进压缩下的语义漂移。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把高层语义放在独立旁路中以约束视觉 latent 的重建，可能为 LVR 中语义与细节的分离、旁路补偿及语义漂移诊断提供参照，但需核查这些语义 token 是否真被下游解码实质使用。
